annotations.title: Check a picture and upload it

description: Fetches a picture from a public link, or takes an attached file, stores it for a design and reports its size in pixels and how big it prints well. PNG, JPG, WEBP, GIF, HEIC, PDF or SVG, up to 25 MB. Pictures that are never ordered are deleted after 30 days.
